claimLevel: DEVICE_MEASURED on one Night 5 run (fnaf4-loop-n5b-teach-20260927T230102385Z) and the retained Nights 1-4 recordings as silence; every floor sits between a measured event and measured silence at the same grid instants. No route is promoted by this file.
why: Fredbear's side sounds (h26 landing LEFT, h25 landing RIGHT: follow AV11/AV17 = 3, g239/g242, channel 8 at 45 %, g497) reach the A2DP mix about 5 dB under the room's own ambience, so a 0.6 s matched filter peaks at 0.32-0.42 against a 0.55 default and they were never published on n5b. Every one of them can only start on the level's 3000 ms grid (the roll g286, the repels g502/g503, the closet ejects g522/g523) and every laugh on its 10000 ms grid (the fakes g530, the room teleports g639/g640 on the 30000 ms one), so the detector publishes low candidates and the runner accepts only those whose onset sits on the grid.

fb-left.means: landed in the living room's LEFT side (AV11 = 3)

fb-right.means: landed in the living room's RIGHT side (AV17 = 3)

laugh.means: one of the five laughs (AV11 = 1..5, g531-g535)

sideGrid.sources: g286 (shadow 0) / g287 (shadow >= 1) rolls; g502/g503 door repels and g522/g523 closet ejects are Every 3000 too

laughGrid.sources: g530 fakes every 10000 ms; g639/g640 (g641/g642 under shadow) teleport to the closet or the bed on the room period, each with a laugh

quietWalk.why: Our own carpet run (h4, s0004, 1477 ms) is the loudest thing in the mix (NCC 0.60-0.85): n5b's walks covered the grid instants at 32.4 s and 35.4 s. A walk is issued so that its run sound starts after the first windowClearMs of the tick's window and ends before the next tick's window opens. Onsets after the issue: backs from a door or the closet 433-597 ms, door and closet double taps 551-701 ms (the record's runOnsets rows, Nights 1-5).

door.why: n5b: a back pressed 1 ms after letting go of the door was dropped 2 times of 2 (the door still reopening); the first frame that reads the door open comes 361-384 ms after the release (frames every ~100 ms). A tick's sound onset trails the game's tick by the A2DP lag (112-244 ms, cal0), so a release 50 ms after the onset leaves the door shut on the tick.

fredcheck.why: g97/g99/g104/g374 set fredcheck at the end of every walk home (door, closet, bed); g558 kills when Fredbear AV6 >= 10, i.e. after 10 s on the bed or in the closet.

idle.why: g566/g564: 25 s without a carpet run (g567) arms the black flash on any Fredbear night; a door hold is not a run.
